calibration.note: Floors below were seeded from the 2026-07-17/18 measured baselines (qwen2.5:7b 84-90 F1; qwen3.5:9b typeAcc 75-88; judge noise +/-7 F1), which were measured against the pre-FEAT-542 43-fixture corpus. This block is stamped against the now-55-fixture corpus (FEAT-542 landed the 12-fixture hard pack the same day) so the stale-calibration check has an accurate count to compare loadFixtures() against, but the floors themselves have NOT yet been re-measured on the 55-fixture set. Treat every floor here as provisional until a live --runs sweep re-baselines it (tracked as a followup, not this FEAT's AC-4 scope).
